totals.note: Earlier policy actors overlap the complete ladder; these are per-prefix totals, not unique-content totals.

original_upload_boundaries.S0: The exporter writes plain actor files; exact manifests enumerate 42 completed-ladder and 41 earlier-ladder actors. No preserved exact historical packaging invocation was found in the bounded search. Complete remote-prefix inventory and content identities are verified directly; this does not reconstruct the packaging command or training provenance.
original_upload_boundaries.S1: walker_s1_collect.py writes setA/probe/roots H5, splits, config, manifest and README before HFStore.upload_run. HFStore excludes hf_upload receipts and writes one after uploading; the collector then writes upload_receipt.json and external collection.json. It assigns hf_revision only to its in-memory manifest, so the saved/uploaded manifest remains pre-upload.
original_upload_boundaries.HFStore: Current uploader ignores hf_upload.json and hf_upload.json.tmp; records receipt after upload then creates/verifies run tag. Current source comparison is not a retroactive executed-source proof.

limitations: No remote payload bytes downloaded, tensor/HDF5 deserialization, policy/model inference, simulator work, uploads or remote mutation.
Metadata confirms exact pinned prefix inventory/content identities; this is not a remote restoration or scientific validity test.
S0/S1 manifests record dirty working trees and lack full executed-source provenance. This audit does not recover missing historical source/seed/split/CNN/media facts.
Policy files are byte-verified without decoding their weights or embedded normalizers. Source manifest labels are not independently re-evaluated.
Tag targets and privacy are observed before/after audit; administrators can change them later.
Successful runtime uploads do not establish coverage of excluded reports, live S4 outputs or final source/report/media archives.
